q: How do the build adapters turn one command source into multiple CLIs?
title: Architecture - Adapters
answer_key: commands/ is the platform-neutral source; each adapter under adapters/ translates it for one target CLI.

q: What should someone know before looping in the person who leads paid coaching on positioning?
title: Ada Lovelace
answer_key: Ada Lovelace leads the paid coaching sessions on positioning.

q: If a decision about broken links conflicts with an earlier note calling them typos, what is the reconciled rule?
gold: wiki/decisions/ADR-2026-06-27 - Rename broken links to wanted notes.md
title: ADR - Rename broken links to wanted notes
answer_key: Broken links to notes that don't exist yet are renamed to wanted-note links rather than treated as typos to fix.
